content.short: Boinkers is a popular free-to-play spin game, originally from Telegram, with a World App mini app.
content.description: Boinkers is a casual free-to-play game where players spin, collect coins and compete with friends, which grew into one of the best-known Telegram mini games. Its Boinkers Coin Party runs as a mini app inside World App, linked from World's official ecosystem directory.
content.meta: Boinkers is a free-to-play spin game from Telegram, with a Coin Party mini app in World App.
